title: Units of measure R1: a backfill door that converts existing free-text units to codes
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Units of measure, release R1 (ADR-0158 U7). Parent: #35339. The ADR is the governing text: [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md) (merged PR #35370, 35bd36082c). Filed on seat 5's word, 2026-11-19.

## What to build
R1 member "a backfill door that converts existing free-text units to codes", loosely mirroring `os migrate record-currency-codes` (`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts#backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`). It rewrites free text in place, from a mapping.

## Open items this card carries
- OI12, backfill half: where the mapping comes from, and what an unmatched value does → #35469.
- **OI8, ruled A on #35339:** the door also reaches a unit field declared on its own (no quantity beside it).
- OI9's choice (#35467) may make this door a precondition for editing old rows, which orders the R1 rollout.

## Blocked
Blocked-by: #35489

Waits on the unitConfig and membership card.

## Done when
The door converts the mapped values and reports or refuses the unmatched ones as OI12 settles. It is idempotent and pinned on SQL and in memory. ADR-0158 is amended.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:server.
